'''Cioppino''' ({{IPAc-en|tʃ|ə|ˈ|p|iː|n|oʊ}}, {{IPA|it|tʃopˈpiːno|lang}}; from {{langx|lij|cioppin}} {{IPA|lij|tʃuˈpiŋ|}}) is a [[fish stew]] originating in [[San Francisco]], California, a dish in [[Italian-American cuisine]] related to various [[fish soup]]s in [[Italian cuisine]].<ref name="nyt">{{cite news |newspaper=New York Times |url=https://www.nytimes.com/1988/04/24/travel/fare-of-the-country-cioppino-fish-stew-from-the-pacific.html?sec=travel&pagewanted=print |title= Cioppino: Fish Stew From the Pacific |first=Elizabeth |last=Riely |date=1988-04-24 |access-date=2007-09-26}}</ref>
